description: WhatsApp chat from an unknown number posing as the office IT team, urging the employee to paste a command into an admin PowerShell window to fix email sync.
rationale: Unverified 'IT support' pressures the user to run an encoded command from a remote host, which is how attackers get initial access.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
